outcome: time to cessation of urinary incontinence
cohort: The study included 102 primiparous adolescents aged 10-19 years who experienced urinary incontinence after vaginal delivery.
finding: Factors identified to prolong the time to cessation of urinary incontinence included maternal age 15-19 years, non-instrumental delivery, adoption of a vertical position during the expulsion stage of delivery, and absence of episiotomy, with a median UI cessation time of 16 months.
mod_finding: Non-instrumental delivery was associated with a longer time to cessation of urinary incontinence compared to instrumental delivery.
